title: Game as a Service
tagline: Game as a service is a multi-tenant platform that allow users to upload their games and monetize them directly.
description: I tried to make us of tableland as a database for a game as a service platform. The idea behind the platform is that users might be able to submit the games they developed and monetize the use of the games by requiring an NFT once a visitor of the game page wants to use it. The subdomains that users might be able to submit are the endpoint for other individuals to find the games they are looking for.
how_its_made: It is a multitenant app build with NEXT JS. I intended to use Tableland as the database layer to be able to store on chain the interactions of the users within the platform. It is supposed to let the user create space where he/she can upload the games and visitors can simply go to the game creator subdomain.
